newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU inflation data national figures.
newsitem.headline: EU inflation data national figures.

text.p: The following is a table of annual inflation figures for January which have been published previously by national statistics agencies.
The European Commission will issue its harmonised inflation data at 1100 GMT.

NOTE - According to the European Union's Maastricht treaty, a country's average inflation rate over a year should not exceed by more than 1.5 percentage points that of, at most, the three best performing member states in terms of price stability.
However, analysts are uncertain how this reference value should be calculated.
In a report last Novemeber, the European Commission used six different methods to calculate the rate which should not be exceeded for meeting the price stability criterion.
Regarding the period of one year, two main approaches are possible, according to the EU executive.
One is to use the year-on-year change of monthly indicators or using the average change of the last twelve months over the preceeding twelve months.
In its November report the Commission used the latter approach. It calculated the reference value by calculating the unweighted average of three best performing countries plus 1.5 percentage points.
